rules: same accession or source section id means same physical section
same ordered spot ids, coordinates and count signatures means duplicate
strict spot subset with identical shared counts means filtered version of same section

requirements: each engineering fix adds a minimal regression test and one changelog row

all failures and unsupported cells remain visible
no new method candidate or SOTA claim
